summary.text: Jenson Altzman (born April 25, 2002) is an American racing driver who currently competes in the IMSA SportsCar Championship for Myers Riley Motorsports. He is a member of the Ford Racing Junior Team.

Álvaro Carpe (Murcia, 5 de junio de 2007) es un piloto español de motociclismo que desde 2025 corre en el Campeonato del Mundo de Motociclismo de Moto3 para el equipo Red Bull KTM Ajo. Anteriormente fue campeón de la Red Bull Rookies Cup y del JuniorGP en 2024.

Ezequiel Pérez Companc (born 5 July 1994 in Buenos Aires) is an Argentine racing driver. He currently competes in the GT World Challenge Europe for Saintéloc Racing.

He belongs to the prominent Pérez Companc family, being the son of Jorge and grandson of the Argentine businessman Gregorio Pérez Companc. Holding an FIA Silver rating, he has driven for sports car operations such as GRT Grasser Racing Team and Belgian Audi Club Team WRT. In 2020, he established his own racing team, Madpanda Motorsport, where he serves as team principal and primary driver.

summary.text: Preston Joseph Pardus (born February 15, 1997) is an American professional racing driver. He competes part-time in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series, driving the No. 50 Chevrolet Camaro SS for Pardus Racing Inc. He also competes in the Sports Car Club of America. Pardus won the Spec Miata class at the 2017 SCCA National Championship Runoffs and claimed the 2020 Super Sweep in the Spec Miata division. He is the son of former NASCAR driver Dan Pardus.
